about: Modules moved to the new design system. 'functions'/'prefixes' are the code that draws the module (the design check counts old patterns in them). 'sections' is the checklist: every approved Design Kit section, marked done (applied), kept (Sam chose today's look for that piece), n/a (the module has nothing of that kind) or todo. A module can only be 'converted' when no section is todo. Show this checklist with every before/after picture. See .claude/design.md, section 2.

type: Administration is not inside the .ks scope yet, so text sizes, corners and spacing are today's.
